title: Fan-in of an embedded circuit
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, and let $D$ be a circuit with $m$ inputs that is well formed and whose gates each have at most two inputs. For any list of source vertices and any natural number $L$, every gate in the embedding of $D$ is well formed and has at most two inputs.
